purpose.local-network: T3 Code connects to devices on your local network for remote environments and commands run by terminals and coding agents.
purpose.camera: T3 Code lets commands run by terminals and coding agents use the camera.
purpose.microphone: T3 Code lets commands run by terminals and coding agents use the microphone.
purpose.notifications: T3 Code tells you when a thread finishes, fails, or needs input or approval.
